name: Purchase
description: A purchase that needs the yes of several people at once. Submitting it creates one Approval document for each approver, through the outbox. Each approver grants or refuses their own; either refreshes the purchase, which counts with a LOOKUP over the Approval class and moves by its own guards: rejected at the first refusal, approved when as many have granted as it needs, two unless it says otherwise. The Approval sample names this class and this class names it, so the two are defined together, with DefineClasses.
title: "Purchase " & number

approvers.label: Approvers
approvers.description: The ids of the people asked to approve it, one Approval each.

needed.label: Approvals needed
needed.description: How many must grant it: two, unless the purchase says otherwise.

granted.label: Granted
granted.description: How many approvers have granted it, counted again each time one answers.
granted.formula: LOOKUP(Approval, COUNT(id), purchase = ID() AND state = "granted")

refused.label: Refused
refused.description: How many approvers have refused it, counted again each time one answers.
refused.formula: LOOKUP(Approval, COUNT(id), purchase = ID() AND state = "refused")

request.label: Request
request.description: What is bought, and for how much.

approval.label: Approval
approval.description: Who is asked, how many must grant it, and how they answered.

descriptions.draft: Its author writes it and names the approvers.
descriptions.waiting: Each approver has an Approval to answer.
descriptions.approved: As many approvers as it needs granted it.

transitions.name: submit
transitions.label: Submit
transitions.description: The author sends the purchase for approval, and one Approval is created for each approver.
Taken by itself at the first refusal.
Taken by itself when as many have granted it as it needs.
